observations.observation: Empty text still creates the initial line record and deterministic block metrics.
CRLF and CR are replaced by LF before layout; each newline starts another line, including a trailing empty line.
Trailing whitespace is excluded from measured line width and justification distribution while its logical characters remain.
Finite-width normal wrapping searches backward for the most recent allowed break and marks the prior line soft-wrapped.
The nowrap option disables the overflow wrapping branch, and an unbreakable run may exceed maxWidth.
Indentation initializes the first line offset; break-word permits a hard overflow split when no earlier break is available.
Per-run font size scales metrics; a line selects its tallest height and lowest baseline, and letter spacing advances glyph placement.
Center and right alignment translate a line; justification distributes remaining width only across non-trailing whitespace on soft-wrapped lines.
Numeric, keyword, and percentage anchors translate final glyph positions, carets, and reported bounds.
Bidi levels are resolved for the paragraph, then reorder segments are applied independently within each constructed line.
Start-indexed style maps are converted into font, size, and vertical-offset ranges before font runs are split at size boundaries.
Fallback is selected by Unicode code point with explicit surrogate-pair carry-forward; combining and broader grapheme grouping are not resolved as one unit.
Block bounds follow line layout, visible bounds union scaled visible glyph extents, and additional chunk bounds are emitted only for renderer culling.
Caret edges follow bidi direction and missing character positions inside ligatures are filled by evenly dividing the ligature width.
Selection ranges are normalized and clipped before adjacent character rectangles are accumulated.
A new rectangle starts across line or direction discontinuities, then overlapping rectangles on the same row are merged.
